name: Steward of the Harvest
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, exile up to three target land cards from your graveyard.
Creatures you control have all activated abilities of all land cards exiled with this creature.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control have all activated abilities of all land cards exiled with this creature.

needs.what: a static ability that gives each permanent matching its `affects` filter every activated ability (mana abilities included) printed on the cards matching an `exiled_with: self` selector, read live from exile so the set changes as cards are exiled with the source, and ending when the source leaves the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `grant_ability` static only hands over a fixed ability written in the card's own `grantable_abilities` by index, so it cannot borrow abilities from whatever cards happen to be exiled; `imprint_characteristics` reads an exiled card but copies only power, toughness and creature types (Duplicant), never abilities; `exiled_with` exists only as an effect selector key, not in `static_filter_keys`
